headline: CREMA DE ALCAUCHOFA Y QUINOA
content: Ingredients: • 10 hearts of artichoke halves • 1 cup of quinoa • 2 stalks of celery • 1½ liters of water • ½ teaspoon salt • Juice of half lemon • 1 cup evaporated milk • ¼ cup olive oil • 2 tablespoons butter • 3 cloves garlic minced Preparation: Puts the artichokes, quinoa, and celery in a pot along with some water and let boil during 15 minutes. Let cool down, remove the celery and blend everything together with the evaporated milk. Heat oven to 180°C. Separately, over medium heat add a tablespoon of olive oil and melt the butter. Fry the garlic until golden brown, adds cream of artichoke and season with salt. Cook for few more minutes avoiding boiling point. Mix well and bake until toasted and crunchy. Serve hot topped with bread cubes and remaining Parmesan cheese. Decorate with parsley leaves.
